meta.summary: The saddle $x^2 - y^2$ at levels −2 to 2, with the zero level crossing at the origin.

mkp-math:contour@1.name: contour
mkp-math:contour@1.about: Contour lines of f(x, y), computed by marching squares, with a point to drag that traces the level through it.

inputs.name: levels
inputs.about: the levels to draw; empty picks nine evenly between the lowest and highest value

inputs.name: probe
inputs.about: a point to drag, with the level through it

value.expr: map(range(0, n), b => map(range(0, n), a => f(gx(a), gy(b))))
if(len(levels) > 0, levels, map(range(1, 9), k => round(100 (lo + k (hi - lo)/10))/100))

values.name: row
values.body: flatten(map(range(0, n - 1), a => cell((gx(a), gy(b)), (gx(a + 1), gy(b)), (gx(a + 1), gy(b + 1)), (gx(a), gy(b + 1)), vals[b][a], vals[b][a + 1], vals[b + 1][a + 1], vals[b + 1][a], c)))
comment: the segments of level c in row b of cells

value.expr: map(shown, c => map(range(0, n - 1), b => row(b, c)))
map(range(0, n - 1), b => if(probe, row(b, here), []))

label.text: Contour lines of the function, and a point to drag

value.expr: "$f(\val{p.x}, \val{p.y}) = \val{here}$; the bold line is that level."

ast.v: $f(\val{0}, \val{1}) = \val{2}$; the bold line is that level.

value.expr: "Levels " + join(shown, ", ") + if(min(shown) < 0, "; the negative ones are dashed.", ".")

local:mkp-math:contour@1:row#0.name: row
local:mkp-math:contour@1:row#0.src: flatten(map(range(0, n - 1), a => cell((gx(a), gy(b)), (gx(a + 1), gy(b)), (gx(a + 1), gy(b + 1)), (gx(a), gy(b + 1)), vals[b][a], vals[b][a + 1], vals[b + 1][a + 1], vals[b + 1][a], c)))

core:text@1.name: text
core:text@1.about: A styled run of inline Markdown with inline maths.

core:canvas@1.name: canvas
core:canvas@1.about: A 2D coordinate space with layers drawn in the order written.

inputs.name: aspect
inputs.about: width over height; 0 means from the ranges

inputs.name: view
inputs.about: 3D camera: azimuth and elevation in degrees

mkp-math:cell#1.name: cell
mkp-math:cell#1.src: pair(edge(p0, p1, v0, v1, c) + edge(p1, p2, v1, v2, c) + edge(p2, p3, v2, v3, c) + edge(p3, p0, v3, v0, c), ((v0 + v1 + v2 + v3)/4 >= c) == (v0 >= c))

mkp-math:edge#0.name: edge
mkp-math:edge#0.src: if((u >= c) != (v >= c), [cross(p, q, u, v, c)], [])
